summary: Frontend-only testing for Luchii badge and About Luchii page. All testids and flows verified: /about-luchii renders page/logo/5 pillars/family/create+models buttons (both navigate correctly); footer-about-luchii-link present on home; /s/TEST-badge-f512c8 share page shows share-luchii-badge overlay; after login as motion.tester, /gallery shows gallery-luchii-badge-TEST-badge-f512c8 overlay on the seeded image; regression on /, /models, /create, /video, /audio loads with zero console errors. Code review of Generator.jsx, Studio.jsx, Share.jsx, VideoShare.jsx, Gallery.jsx confirmed presence of result-luchii-badge, {kind}-luchii-badge (image/video/music), share-luchii-badge, video-share-luchii-badge, and gallery-video-luchii-badge-{id}. No generation triggered.
critical_code_review_comments: LuchiiBadge supports testId prop properly and uses pointer-events-none so it never blocks underlying click handlers.
AboutLuchii page uses semantic headings and consistent brand palette; no issues.
test_credentials: motion.tester@luchiiapp.com / Motion123! (login via POST /api/auth/login works; UI login dialog had an overlay issue but direct token injection via localStorage.luchii_token is reliable for automation).
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded TEST-badge-f512c8 from previous iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthContext stores token in localStorage key 'luchii_token'. For future automation, POST /api/auth/login then set localStorage before navigating to protected routes to bypass the login dialog overlay interception.
